headline: The North Sea Hid a Catastrophe for 43 Million Years. We Finally Know What Hit It.

seo.meta_title: Silverpit Crater: North Sea Asteroid Impact Confirmed
seo.meta_description: Scientists confirm the Silverpit Crater is a 43-million-year-old asteroid impact that triggered a tsunami taller than Big Ben. Here's what the evidence shows.
